head_coach.name: Jesse Marsch
head_coach.play_style_summary: High-intensity 'Maplepressing' system centered on high pressing from the front, compact lines of four in a mid-block, quick vertical transitions, a high defensive line, and rapid attacking play utilizing pace out wide to exploit spaces immediately after turnovers.

key_players.name: Alphonso Davies
key_players.performance_stats: Average FotMob rating of 7.11 in Bundesliga, covers the left flank with elite speed and carries the ball into the final third. Outstanding progressiveness with 266 career chances created.

key_players.name: Jonathan David
key_players.performance_stats: Lethal finisher with intelligent movement off the ball. Energetic in leading the high press from the front, dropping deep to connect play, and exploiting spaces behind defences.

key_players.name: Ismaël Koné
key_players.performance_stats: Robust box-to-box midfielder with high pass completion rate (~85%). Excelled in carrying the ball forward and shielding the defensive unit during transitional moments.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Recovering from a right hamstring strain sustained in May 2026; missed the World Cup opener and remains in return-to-play protocol.
Ruled out of the 2026 World Cup after undergoing surgery to repair a ruptured anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) suffered in late May 2026.
Recovering from a fractured left tibia sustained in October; although on the roster, his availability is limited due to sensitivity and modified training.
